hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */umit-mobilya-server/node_modules/*) exit 0 ;; */umit-mobilya-server/*.js) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; node --check "$f" || exit 2 ;; esac; }

jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */umit-mobilya-server/node_modules/*) exit 0 ;; */umit-mobilya-server/*.js) : ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; w=""; case "$f" in */routes/*.route.js) u=$(grep -nE "^[[:space:]]*router\.(post|put|delete)\(" "$f" | grep -v "requireAuth" | grep -vE "\(\s*'/(login|signup|logout|filter)'" || true); [ -n "$u" ] && w="Unprotected mutating route(s) in $(basename "$f") -- no requireAuth: $(echo "$u" | tr '\n' ' ')"; b=$(basename "$f" .route.js); i="${f%/routes/*}/routes/index.js"; if [ -f "$i" ] && ! grep -q "$b\.route" "$i"; then w="$w${w:+ | }Router $(basename "$f") is not mounted in routes/index.js -- it will be silently dead."; fi ;; esac; [ -z "$w" ] && exit 0; jq -n --arg m "$w" '{systemMessage: $m, hookSpecificOutput: {hookEventName: "PostToolUse", additionalContext: ("Server convention check: " + $m + "  Fix: add requireAuth from middleware/auth.middleware.js to every POST/PUT/DELETE route (public exceptions are only /login, /signup, /logout, /filter), and mount every new router in routes/index.js with router.use(\"/api/<x>\", <x>Routes).")}}'; exit 0; }
